note: Fixed narrator lines. They never contain guests' names. audio is the file name: a Show Pack keeps it in its own audio/ folder. Without the file, the line shows as a caption only.

lines.text: An unlit scroll appears in the clearing. Let us invoke the letters of old!
Ah! The scroll accepts your offering, and the runes begin to reveal themselves!
Alas, that letter finds no home here. A lantern's light fades into the twilight.
The pixies whisper into the clearing…
Take heed! Only one lantern remains to guide your path!
The final light goes dark. The forest reclaims the scroll's secrets.
Brilliant inkcraft! The phrase is illuminated, and the forest rejoices!
The sundial's shadow falls. The library closes its doors for now.
